RE-SCOPED 2026-10-03 BY USER RULING; DEVICE SELECTED 2026-10-05 BY PROBE E3. On 2026-10-03 the user ruled REVISE on this record -- not ABANDONED, and not revived as filed. The ruling is carried as a checked Phase 0 box in specs/ROADMAP.md ("RULED 2026-10-03 by the user: REVISE"), and the ROADMAP Fronts table has moved this task off the Parked row onto the gluing route. The authoritative scope input is Section B and the section "The 711 tension" of specs/721_decidability_programme_review_l_and_lplus/followup-scope-spec.md, whose anchors are re-verified in that file's Section 0 rows 10-11. Everything below the ORIGINAL SCOPE marker is superseded and must not be read as current.

WHAT THIS TASK NOW NAMES. The universal-summary substrate for the stab (box-dot) fibre check on the seam-gluing route to decidability of full L-plus. The seam-gluing route presents a possible world as a backward ray glued to a forward ray at a seam, and presents the stab fibre as a path space (Probe718.seamFibreEquiv, plusStab_iff_rays, seamOmegaEquiv, plusStab_iff_omega, all under [F.IsRegular], in specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/stab-fibre-is-ray-product.lean). Checking stab over that path space requires a summary device that is UNIVERSAL -- quantifying over all paths -- and therefore complementation-shaped. This task is the record of that substrate: WHICH device, and what it costs to build.

THE DEVICE IS NOW SELECTED. PROBE E3 IS RUN AND HAS REPORTED. E3 was filed and completed as task 732; its deliverable is specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/device-selection-probe.lean (383 lines, 0 sorries, standard axioms only, wired into scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh, collection gate PASS all 16 wired probes, exit 0). The probe file's own header is the authoritative record of what it found and what it refuses to claim; the three parts below must all be carried together, because taking any one without the others misrepresents the result.

(1) NEGATIVE RESULT, machine-checked, High confidence: the two specified shapes CANNOT discriminate between devices. On box-dot(Fp) and box-dot(Pp) the candidate devices are DEVICE-INERT on finite fixtures. Over an arbitrary finite step graph the universal summary reduces to ultimately periodic (lasso) root paths by PIGEONHOLE ALONE -- no Ramsey, no automata, no determinization (Probe732Device.allPathsMeet_iff_lasso, with the backward dual on the reversed step relation at Probe732Device.allBwdPathsMeet_iff_lasso) -- and the per-path acceptor for "eventually p" is a 2-state DETERMINISTIC automaton (Probe732Device.detRun_accepts_iff). On the real formula, on the shared Bool fixture the necessity probe used, Probe732Device.stab_will_iff_lasso restates PlusTruthAt Mf tau t (.stab (someFuture (.atom pa))) as that lasso-restricted summary, coinciding with the reachability summaries already recorded by Probe718FiniteGraph.will_iff_allPathsMeet / Probe718FiniteGraph.decide_will (forward) and Probe719Backward.pastStab_iff_allBwdPathsMeet (backward). All four candidates therefore coincide on these shapes. The shapes do not discriminate, and no later work may claim they do.

(2) A REFUTATION, machine-checked, High confidence: pigeonhole-tier lasso summaries are NOT sufficient in general. Probe732Device.not_lasso_sufficient_on_chain falsifies them on the infinite acyclic fibre <Z, b = a - 1>, where the lasso-restricted summary is vacuously True while the universal summary is False. That is precisely the regime forced by the failure of finite width: the in-tree library statement is FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.PlusSlicedCertificate.NoFiniteWidth.not_finite_width_fmp at FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/PlusSlicedCertificate/Limits/NoFiniteWidth.lean:1280, which is the name E3's own file cites and the name any future work should cite. NAME NOTE, verified 2026-10-05: the earlier text of this record cited Probe710.not_finite_width_fmp (and Probe710.not_sliced_complete) in specs/archive/710_sliced_class_incompleteness_characterization/probes/NoFiniteWidthModel.lean; those declarations DO exist there (lines 1164 and 1154, inside namespace Probe710, and Probe710.not_finite_width_fmp is named explicitly in the exemption comment of scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh), so that citation was not a phantom. It is nonetheless the archived probe-file name, not the library name; cite the FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.PlusSlicedCertificate.NoFiniteWidth path above as the durable anchor and treat the Probe710 names as provenance. CONSEQUENCE, which is the actual design constraint handed to this task: whatever the substrate uses must work over the TIME AXIS with a finite alphabet of per-time summaries, NOT over states.

(3) THE SELECTION, made on infrastructure and literature evidence rather than on behaviour, since (1) shows behaviour on these shapes cannot decide it. BUILD THE SUBSTRATE ON THE TIME-AXIS RAMSEY-COLOURED SUMMARY, candidate (d), via the already-in-tree FormalSystem.Metalogic.WeakCanonical.infinite_ramsey_pairs (FormalSystem/Metalogic/WeakCanonical/GroupModel/RamseyFactorization.lean:146; proved from scratch there, #print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], absent from Mathlib at pin v4.33.0-rc1), FRAMED BY the MSO-over-<Z,<> quasimodel route, candidate (c): Hodkinson-Wolter-Zakharyaschev, APAL 106 (2000), Theorem 15 (flows including <Z,<>), and Gabbay-Kurucz-Wolter-Zakharyaschev 2003, Theorem 1.28 (MSO theory of <Z,<> decidable), Lemma 11.23 (quasimodel existence as an MSO sentence), Theorem 13.6 (S5 x linear time). Route (c) is the FRAME because it covers the target flow exactly and needs no Safra construction; (d) is the SUBSTRATE because its one non-trivial ingredient already exists in this tree on standard axioms, whereas (c)'s discharge theorem (Buechi's theorem) has no Lean formalization and under the zero-debt policy could not be cited but would have to be proved. Candidates (a) Safra/Piterman determinization and (b) Safraless procedures (Kupferman-Vardi, FOCS 2005) are NOT SELECTED, for stated reasons: both are inert on the probed shapes (the acceptor is already deterministic, so there is nothing to determinize and no complementation to avoid); Mathlib carries zero omega-automata, Buechi, parity or Rabin infrastructure at the pin; no formalization of Safra or Piterman determinization exists in ANY proof assistant; and (b)'s FOCS 2005 source is WANTED in the Literature index (only its 2001 rank-construction core, Kupferman-Vardi "Weak Alternating Automata Are Not That Weak", is in corpus).

NO LONGER BLOCKED; THE DO-NOT-PLAN/DO-NOT-IMPLEMENT BAR IS LIFTED. The former blocked reason carried in this field -- "DEVICE NOT YET SELECTED; PROBE E3 PENDING" -- is DISCHARGED and removed, and with it the instruction not to plan and not to implement. Dependencies [732] are SATISFIED (732 is completed). Planning may proceed on the selection in (3), under every constraint restated below.

TWO HONEST LIMITS E3 RECORDED, which this record carries forward rather than smoothing over. FIRST: the box-dot(Pp) side was left at the STEP-GRAPH level (Probe732Device.allBwdPathsMeet_iff_lasso, by reversal), because no backward Bool-fixture bridge exists and building one is substrate-adjacent; the backward shape on the real formula is fixed by Probe719Backward.pastStab_iff_allBwdPathsMeet on the asymmetric fixture (specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/backward-dual-asymmetric-fixture.lean:577), not re-proved in E3. SECOND: the claim that routes (c) and (d) share Buechi's Ramsey core is LOW CONFIDENCE -- framing, not a finding, resting on background not re-read during E3 -- and its named resolving check is Thomas 1997, "Languages, Automata, and Logic" (in corpus as thomas_1997_languages), on Buechi complementation. Neither limit may be dropped in a plan or presented as settled.

CONSTRAINTS THAT SURVIVE E3 UNCHANGED. NO COMPLEXITY BOUND IS CLAIMED, by E3 or by this record. The CTL-star 2EXPTIME LOWER bound (task 713, ARGUED, not proved) remains a SANITY CEILING that any later-proposed procedure must clear, and is NEVER a source of an upper bound. E3 establishes no behavioural superiority of (d) over (c), and no adequacy of (d) beyond the probed shapes. The first behavioural discrimination between (c) and (d) lives on a finitely presented INFINITE fibre with a per-time alphabet (the quasimodel setting), where (d) must colour time pairs and (c) must write the MSO sentence; that is substrate work, and it belongs to THIS record.

PROHIBITION, PRESERVED. The prohibition recorded in task 719's own description stands as recorded: NO PHASE OF TASK 719 MAY BEGIN BUILDING A DETERMINIZATION SUBSTRATE. Task 719 has since been completed and archived (specs/archive/719_ray_layer_seam_gluing_and_stab_fibre), so the prohibition is now provenance rather than a live gate, but its reason is unchanged and transfers to the consumer relation: the substrate is built HERE and consumed downstream, never absorbed into the consuming record. E3's own file is explicit on the matching point -- nothing in it begins a determinization substrate or any other substrate; detRun is a counterexample to the need for determinization on these shapes, not a component of anything.

CONSUMER. The consumer of this substrate is task 735 (decidable_stab_check_ray_product_assembly, status not_started, dependencies [711]) -- where a decidable stab check on the path-space presentation is to be assembled. This replaces the former pointer to Deliverable 5 of the ray-layer/seam-gluing task (719), which has been completed and archived. The L-plus sliced finite model property record (712) is NOT the consumer and cannot become one: the statement 712 was filed to prove is machine-checked FALSE.

OPERATOR FLAG: METADATA DEFECT. This record's file_scope is literal null in specs/state.json. Give it a real declared scope -- at minimum the substrate's intended Lean path(s) and specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/ -- BEFORE any implement dispatch, so territory ownership is checkable.

WHY REVISE RATHER THAN ABANDON. The ROADMAP's former ABANDONED recommendation was RIGHT ABOUT THE ROUTE THIS TASK ORIGINALLY NAMED -- Emerson-Jutla 1988 determinization via Reynolds 2001, for the finite model property of task 712 -- which is closed along with the refuted 712. It was WRONG ABOUT THE NEED this task was filed to make visible, because that need has been re-demonstrated on a DIFFERENT question. Probe718PathQuantifier.exists_ne_stab and Probe718PathQuantifier.exists_ne_universal (specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/path-quantifier-alternation.lean) prove, on the shared two-state Bool fixture, that the existential (nondeterministic) per-path summary is True everywhere while the stab-of-eventually value is False everywhere (Probe718FiniteGraph.decide_will in specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/finite-graph-stab-summary.lean, with a self-contained twin Probe718PathQuantifier.decide_will in the path-quantifier file). So a universal, complementation-shaped summary device is NECESSARY there and a nondeterministic summary is UNSOUND -- an elementary, finite, non-automata-theoretic divergence. THOSE PROBES DID NOT SHOW THAT SAFRA/PITERMAN SPECIFICALLY IS THAT DEVICE, and E3 has now ruled Safra/Piterman OUT (see (3)). Neither prior record anticipated that the probes would answer device necessity rather than the FMP-route question this task was filed on.

REVIVAL CONDITION: MET. The condition recorded in specs/718_omega_sequence_decidability_full_lplus/.decisions.json, cycle 1 -- "Revive 711 only after R1's falsification probes 1-3 land, so determinization is funded on evidence of necessity rather than expectation" -- is MET: those probes landed in task 718's Phases 2, 3 and 5 and are wired by scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh. The outstanding gate WAS device selection (E3); that gate is now cleared too, and no gate remains.

ORIGINAL SCOPE (superseded 2026-10-03; retained for provenance only). BLOCKED AND DELIBERATELY NOT SCHEDULED. This task exists to make a dependency VISIBLE, not to be worked. WHAT IT NAMED: the only known proof route to the finite model property for FULL L-plus (task 712) is the deterministic-automata route the CTL-star proofs take -- Emerson and Jutla 1988 via Reynolds 2001, which lets a deterministic Rabin linear automaton run in the background along each path; that route needs omega-automata DETERMINIZATION (Safra's construction, or Piterman's improvement) together with the Rabin or parity acceptance infrastructure it rests on. WHY BLOCKED: neither this tree nor Mathlib has any of it, and task 706's research recorded the route as OUT OF REACH (its decision D4). ITS SOLE FUNCTION was to be the named, honest blocker of the full L-plus finite model property. That function is discharged: 712's statement is refuted, so the blocker it named no longer gates anything, and this record is re-scoped as above rather than closed.
